heading, Meet the Fertifa family, level 1
Fertifa is the UK and Europe's leading reproductive healthcare provider on a mission to make reproductive healthcare accessible to everyone.
heading, Meet the Fertifa clinical leaders, level 2
Our clinical team are at the heart of what we do. Led by Dr. Gidon Lieberman, our best-in-class clinical team provide patients with unlimited 121 advice, expert wellbeing support and treatment.

Gidon is a leading gynaecologist and reproductive medicine specialist. With over 25 years of experience in reproductive health, his specialist skills include menopause, fertility, key-hole surgery, and ultrasound. His clinical interests and expertise include general gynaecology, as well as more complex menopause and fertility challenges. Gidon has experience working in both NHS hospitals and as the Medical Director in IVF clinics. He is a British Fertility Society Trainer (in ultrasound) and is an Advanced Certificate Trainer for the British Menopause Society.
Unexplained subfertility and complex fertility issues
Expertise in PCOS, endometriosis, menstrual health, and surgical management of fibroids
Male and female mid-life health challenges
end of listitem, level 1, position 1, set size 3

Professor Asif Muneer is an expert in the field of andrology which includes the management of male benign and malignant genital diseases including erectile dysfunction, Peyronie's disease and male infertility. His specialist interests include male genital cancers, male infertility, erectile dysfunction, penile prosthesis surgery, vasectomy reversal, surgical sperm retrieval and Peyronie’s disease.
Men's health concerns, including erectile dysfunction
Male-related cancers, such as prostate and testicular cancers
Male fertility including testing, treatment, and optimising male fertility
end of listitem, level 1, position 2, set size 3

Holly is a leading fertility specialist, with over 10 years of clinical experience. With specialist skills in early pregnancy, sexual health, contraception (including vasectomy), egg and sperm donor programmes, and menopause. Holly has experience leading the nursing team at one of London's best fertility clinics (and Fertifa partner), The Evewell. Holly has extensive experience in all parts of the fertility journey, including supporting LGBTQ+ patients and gender affirmation challenges, pregnancy loss care, PCOS and early pregnancy. Holly holds a British Menopause Society Management of Menopause Certificate.
Fertility treatment, with a specialism in egg and sperm donor programmes
Early pregnancy, pregnancy loss, post-partum health
end of listitem, level 1, position 3, set size 3
heading, The Fertifa clinical team, level 2

Our nurses practitioners and clinical advisors and are the very first point of contact for our patients. They guide our patients along their reproductive health journeys, no matter what these journeys make look like.

Danielle brings over 15 years of specialist experience in women’s health, with a strong focus on fertility care. Danielle has led donation care teams, gaining deep expertise in both donor and recipient support through complex fertility journeys. She is committed to providing informed, compassionate, and patient-centred care. As a dedicated patient advocate, Danielle works to ensure everyone can access the right clinical support, enabling patients to make informed decisions while navigating the legal and medical aspects of fertility with confidence.

Fertifa was born out of our personal experiences with reproductive health. We've seen first hand how difficult going through reproductive health challenges can be, especially whilst managing careers and busy lives around it.​ Here's the Fertifa family.
